title: AR32003: Specification
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Definition, importance and use of specification: principles and practices,
drawing of specification clauses. General and special clauses. Specification
of common building materials including carriage and stacking of materials.
Specification of simple construction. Specifications of BIS and other
Institutions. General abbreviations used in specifications. Specification of
new building materials.
